fusions.name: Skimmed Spicule
fusions.desc: Skims a coral spicule at the first enemy in front of you for 4 damage. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have flown or run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Gull's Drop
fusions.desc: Carries a coral head aloft and drops it on an enemy up to 7 tiles away for 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Lifted Carapace
fusions.desc: Grows a light shell over you that absorbs the next 16 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 5% while it holds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wavetop Glide

riders.text: you skim over it faster than over ground
and the reef below mends you while you are over it
and nothing that has to wade can reach you

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster over it, from silver your health recovers 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
